532201.name: Ice Missile II
532201.description:
Spreads wings and takes flight, then fires multiple ice balls at a single Nikke, dealing damage greater than Ice Missile I.
This skill can only be used when the Source of Coldness part is present.
Ice balls can be intercepted.

532202.name: Frozen Spear
532202.description: Emits a linear arc of electricity from its right head at a single Nikke, dealing damage.

532203.name: Frozen Orb
532203.description:
Lobs a massive ice ball at a single Nikke, dealing damage.
The massive ice ball can be intercepted.

532204.name: Ice Breath
532204.description:
Hits all Nikkes with dragon breath, dealing damage.
Deals significant sustained damage if the attack hits.

532205.name: Frost Shield
532205.description:
Surrounds itself with cold air for protection.
Reduces the damage taken while skill is in effect.

532206.name: Ice Storm
532206.description: Creates wind with its wings, dealing damage to all Nikkes.
